content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Portland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours. Critically, no prior work experience is required—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-career professionals entering Portland's healthcare, financial services, technology, and maritime sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format compresses the required education into a focused schedule, allowing you to balance training with your current role while gaining hands-on project management fundamentals from active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, complete your official PMI application and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance through this process to ensure your eligibility is confirmed before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review CAPM domains and test-taking strategies. We offer practice questions and clarification sessions to build your confidence, then schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner when you're ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteering, or professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in evolving project management practices.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

fq_items.question: Is CAPM certification worth it for Portland healthcare project managers?

Combined with regional pay competitiveness in health systems, certification often accelerates advancement and eligibility for higher-responsibility positions.

fq_items.question: Which Portland employers actively hire CAPM-certified project managers?

Educational institutions and city government also recognize CAPM as a marker of professional readiness, though certification requirements vary by role and organization.
